draft.title: Becoming pharaoh
card: Thutmose II died, and his son Thutmose III was still a young child. Hatshepsut first acted as regent, which means she governed on the boy's behalf.
Within a few years, around the seventh year of Thutmose III's reign, she took the full titles of a pharaoh. These included the royal names and the title King of Upper and Lower Egypt.
She did not remove Thutmose III. She ruled as co-regent, so two rulers were named together. Hatshepsut held the senior position, and he stayed on the throne as a king.
Her change from regent to pharaoh was a change in her own status. The child king was still counted as a ruler, but she acted as the main one.
draft.remember: Hatshepsut moved from governing for a child to taking pharaoh's titles, while Thutmose III stayed king beside her.

a.q: What change marked Hatshepsut's move from regent to pharaoh?
opts: She took the full royal titles and ruled as co-regent
She married Thutmose III to share his throne
She replaced Thutmose III and ruled alone
She gave up her role and returned to the royal household
a.why: As regent she governed for the boy. As pharaoh she took the full titles but kept Thutmose III as co-regent. The tempting wrong answer is that she replaced him, but he stayed on the throne as a king beside her.
a.clue: Did Thutmose III remain a king after she took the titles?

b.q: A student says, "Hatshepsut became pharaoh by seizing the throne from Thutmose III." Which reply is best supported by the card?
opts: He stayed a king, and she ruled as the senior co-regent
He was removed as king, but only after she took the titles
He was already an adult, so she had to share power with him
He was king in name only, so he had no place in the titles
b.why: The card says Thutmose III was not removed. He remained on the throne and was named together with her as co-regent, while she held the senior position. The tempting wrong answer says he was removed, which the card does not support.
b.clue: Think about who was named as ruler once she took the titles.

a.best: She took the full royal titles and ruled as co-regent

b.best: He stayed a king, and she ruled as the senior co-regent
